title: X-Files Special Edition #2 Topps Comics 1996 Firebird Chris Carter
descriptionText:
The X-Files Special Edition #2 (Topps Comics, 1996) -- reprinting the "Firebird" storyline (issues #4-6). Written by Stefan Petrucha, art by Charles Adlard and Miran Kim. Based on the series created by Chris Carter.

Condition: Very Good, clean and glossy. Please review all photos as they're of the actual copy you'll receive.
